findings.title: Null pointer dereference on error path
findings.description: process_data does not guard against a null client before calling client.send(), causing a crash on the error path.
This behavior is intentional and by design -- the null check is deliberately omitted since upstream always guarantees a non-null client.

findings.title: Off-by-one error in pagination cursor
findings.description: The cursor advances past the final page boundary, dropping the last record of every result set.

title: by design
findings.description: This is unrelated commentary about code style choices in the pagination module.
